# compsoccer.com

> CompSoccer: World Cup 2026 Multilingual News & Match Coverage

## About

CompSoccer (compsoccer.com) is a dedicated World Cup 2026 media site providing
real-time match coverage, news, schedules, standings, and live TV guides in
6 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean.

All match data is sourced from official API-Football feeds.
News articles are produced by our editorial team with AI assistance.

## Content Sections

- /en/          : Homepage — featured news, trending articles, latest updates
- /en/news/     : World Cup 2026 news index (all articles)
- /en/news/:slug : Individual news article (match previews, reviews, analysis)
- /en/schedule/ : Full World Cup 2026 match schedule by stage
- /en/results/  : Match results with scores and match review links
- /en/standings/: Group stage standings (A–H) with promotion/elimination indicators
- /en/matches/:slug : Match detail page with stats, commentary, and lineups
- /en/live-tv/  : Live broadcast guide by region (US, UK, Brazil, Mexico, Japan, Korea, Middle East)

## Multilingual URLs

All sections available in:
- English:    /en/
- Spanish:    /es/
- Portuguese: /pt/
- Arabic:     /ar/  (RTL layout)
- Japanese:   /ja/
- Korean:     /ko/

## Data Sources

- Match fixtures, results, standings: API-Football (official data partner)
- News & analysis: Original reporting + MiniMax AI-assisted content
- Live TV guide: Curated regional broadcast data

## Update Frequency

- Match results: Updated after each match concludes
- News articles: 5–20 new articles per match day
- Standings: Updated after each match day
- Schedule: Updated when fixture dates/times change
